additional_context: MedicationDispense is active in source/fhir.ini. Later FHIR-34000 renamed the not-performed reason element to MedicationDispense.notPerformedReason, and current source represents it as CodeableReference targeting DetectedIssue. Later FHIR-34293 intentionally removed direct MedicationDispense.detectedIssue to avoid bidirectional links, and an existing combined-branch FHIR-34293 commit added Medication Module guidance for DetectedIssue.implicated search/_revinclude retrieval. FHIR-49940 further confirms the current declined/cancelled pattern using status plus notPerformedReason examples.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current MedicationDispense preserves the not-performed reason semantics through status and notPerformedReason, while the direct detectedIssue field should remain absent because it was superseded by FHIR-34293.
